message1_tldr:
Batch inventory movement, oracle persistence, and agentic authorization all landed since yesterday's digest — the biggest cluster of contributor-facing wiring in this cycle.

- **Batch QR inventory movement live** — contributors can now scan, upload, or type a list of QR codes and submit them as a single inventory movement; a same-day fix confirmed all three input methods working.
- **I Ching oracle draws now persisted** — `oracle.truesight.me` writes each draw to the `oracle_logs` repo via the GitHub Contents API; draws are no longer ephemeral.
- **Agentic authorization path open** — trusted agents (Autopilot) can now submit inventory movements that governors have pre-approved; no more manual re-entry for agent-initiated actions.
- **Asset-receipt-ingest GAS live** — the double-entry purchase accounting pipeline lands in the tokenomics sheet; `[ASSET RECEIPT EVENT]` rows are now processed automatically.
- **Gmail draft link stored in interaction history** — contributors get a direct link back to an in-progress outreach draft inside the store interaction history view.
- **Prospect auto-promotion wired** — a replied prospect now advances automatically to Manager Follow-up on send; no manual reclassification needed.
- **Warm-up review queue enriched** — the queue surfaces `body_full` and `prospect_reply_body`; contributors can filter by `?label=` to isolate follow-up cohorts; full reply body and expand view added to UI.
- **Autopilot chat UX hardened** — multi-file upload, batch proposal cards, pending approvals panel, session manager, async message queuing, and bookmarkable session URLs all shipped in a single merge.
- **Contribution Type validation tightened** — agentic context rules hardened and Gary Teh enforced as default contributor; reduces mis-attributed ledger entries.
- **"Field Signals #1 + Signal Brief #1" published** — the Mycelial Economy blog post received a second editorial pass adding DAO signals and the first Signal Brief section to `truesight.me`.
